prompt:
The reference photos show one person, the coach, from the front, the side and 45 degrees. Keep exactly that person: the same face, hair, body, skin tone and clothes.
Make one photorealistic photo, landscape 16:9, for a fitness app's exercise demonstration: the coach in the start position of the exercise "Glute bridge".
Start position: at the top of the glute bridge: head and shoulders resting on the floor, the hips lifted high so the shoulders, hips and knees make one straight line, knees bent at about 90 degrees with the shins upright, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, arms long on the floor by the sides with the palms down
No equipment: only the coach on the studio floor.
Correct form, as the trainer teaches it: Push through the heels. Ribs down, hips up. Squeeze at the top.
Avoid these mistakes: Arching the lower back to get higher. Pushing through the toes.
Camera: a side view: the camera is at a right angle to the body and sees the person's right side. Lying on the back, the head is toward the left edge of the frame and the feet toward the right. The camera is level at hip height, about 3.5 metres away, with a natural 35 mm lens. The whole body is in the frame with about a hand's width of space above the head and below the feet, and the person is in the middle of the frame.
Place: a clean, bright, minimal photo studio: a plain off-white backdrop that curves smoothly into a light grey floor with a faint green-grey tint, with no corners, edges, windows, furniture or decorations in view. Light: soft, even, diffused light from the front and both sides, true-to-life colours, and a soft natural contact shadow on the floor under the person.
Clothes: a fitted short-sleeved training T-shirt in deep forest green (close to #104A2A), black training shorts to just above the knee, and plain grey training shoes with white soles; no logos, no text, no jewellery.
It must look like a real photo of a real person, not a 3D render, a game character or an illustration: natural skin, natural fabric folds, correct anatomy (two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand, natural joints), and hands and feet in full, flat contact with the floor where they rest on it. No text, no logos, no watermark, no mirror, no other people.
